name: wsOpen
description: Open a WebSocket from the browser process (the network service's WebSocket API; cookies never sent). Resolves once the handshake completed: { socketId, protocol }. Messages then arrive as network.onWsMessage { socketId, text } or { socketId, dataBase64 } (one event per whole message, at most 16 MiB, else the socket closes with 1009), and the end as one network.onWsClose { socketId, code, reason, wasClean }. Runs under the egress policy unless allowPrivateNetwork: an IP-literal host in a refused range is refused before dialing, and the peer the handshake connected to is judged unless a proxy lookup says the socket goes through a proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED). Header values may carry `{{secret:NAME}}` for a secret bound to the socket's origin (wss://host matches a secret bound to https://host). At most 16 sockets per connection; every socket is closed when the connection goes away. Errors: INVALID_URL, EGRESS_BLOCKED, WS_CONNECT_FAILED, TOO_MANY_SOCKETS, SECRET_*. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: ws:// or wss:// URL, at most 8192 chars, no embedded credentials.

inputs.name: headers
inputs.description: Extra handshake headers, string -> string; the reserved ones (Host, Cookie, Origin, Sec-*, …) are refused. Values may carry {{secret:NAME}}.

inputs.name: socketId
inputs.description: Caller-chosen id, 8-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]; omitted: the host mints one.

inputs.name: allowPrivateNetwork
inputs.description: Opt this socket out of the egress policy (a local server a person named). Default false.
